title: A trader whose Solarian once line is booked joins the Outer Rim corridor: one trip to Frontier Station (Altais), where The Memorial and the Rim's once missions open to it
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 12:40 UTC (orders ENT-082, block MERCURY: the capitals' once lines by join corridors, one ship first on an unread road; rules F3, F8, F34 tier 4, F35, F37). 50 traders wait docked at Alpha Centauri (table ships 12:16 UTC: 23 born Nebula, 15 Solarian, 12 Voidborn), every once mission of Sol's line booked. Frontier Station's board (now at Altais) pays The Memorial 8,000 once (84 paid of 104 runs in 24 h, 10.4 minutes a run: Voidborn 35 of 41, Outer Rim 41 of 50, Crimson 7 of 9, Solarian 1 of 4; no Nebula-born tried) and Debris Field Reports 4,500. Road: Alpha Centauri to Altais 12 jumps, seven lawless (Miaplacidus to Tidewater), our traders on it at 12:16 UTC. Rule F3: one ship first, hold empty; standing as every join route (the trip is paid by the missions it opens); fill.py widens to lift_to after its runs hold. 2026-11-23 12:56 UTC (Mercury): max_ships 1 -> 3, one result per empire in parallel (F37): the road is read, 76 to 166 readings of each of its systems in 24 h with 0 pirates (data/intel/sightings.jsonl); the unknown is whether Frontier Station offers The Memorial to pilots born Nebula and Solarian. 2026-11-23 12:59 UTC (Mercury): status off. Frontier Station moved from Altais to Distant Light at 11:53 UTC (data/station/stations.json) and every run to it fails at stop 1 ('It's called a Mobile Capital', errors.log ENT-158) until the mobile.py fix of requests.log ENT-452 stands; then the stop is moved to the station's system and the route goes back on. 2026-11-23 13:17 UTC (Mercury): correction to the line above: the runner found the station where it stands now (routes/logs: 'frontier_station stands at distant_light:mobile_capital now', 12:57:52 UTC); the three test ships arrived at Distant Light, 12 jumps, and one docked at Frontier Station. The route stays off for another reason: whether The Memorial is offered to pilots born Nebula is read from those three before a wave follows.
